title: Thai-Indian Chicken Curry
description: A fusion of flavors from Thailand and India, this curry dish is a perfect blend of spicy and tangy. Serve with steamed rice or naan bread.

ingredients.name: Thai red curry paste
ingredients.notes: available in most supermarkets or online

ingredients.name: northern zesty spice blend
ingredients.notes: available online or in Indian grocery stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add coconut milk, spice blend, and curry powder. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
